name: New Intel Arc Pro B70 32GB retail/preorder
price_basis: ASKING/new-retail. Newegg preorders ~$949-1,000 Oct-2026; released Apr-2-2026. PERISHABLE-FIGURE STAMP (added 2026-10-14, uniform across data/supply/ so it is greppable). PRICE CLASS: ASKING price - the rate at which a seller advertises the item for sale, NOT a sold, completed or realised transaction price. OBSERVED: 2026-10-14 RE-VERIFY BY: 2027-01-14 - the repo's quarterly re-verification bar.
notes: Cheapest NEW way to 32GB and cheapest path to 128GB (4x ~ $3,800). 256-bit, ~576-608 GB/s, 230W blower. But per-card decode is SLOWER than a used 3090 and vLLM/SYCL stack is not plug-and-play (native FP8 crashed; needed dynamic-quant BF16). Reasonable for batched/server-style workloads; not a 3090 replacement for single-user speed.
